prompts.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: gameplay art-direction comp, not a poster or an implemented screenshot. Image 1 is the primary composition/camera/HUD/player reference: preserve its 1120:800 aspect, close orthographic top-down camera, central small brown-haired goggle-wearing female adventurer with ivory-and-teal clothes and pistol, four square pillars at the exact same positions, anvil right, pallet lower right, cropped workbench lower left, stone workshop floor, root at upper right. Preserve player height about 60px per 800px frame, do NOT make the protagonist a large portrait. Preserve the dark thin-framed top and bottom HUD bands and their arrangement; keep simple Japanese UI, top HP 4.0/4, orange bar, bottom pistol ammo infinity. Image 2 supplies ONLY enemy identities: small brass rounded hammer automaton, olive quadruped fire-pouch lizard, brown quilled beast; do NOT copy its composition or older UI HP. Replace the artificial horizontal row of five sample projectiles in image 1 with a plausible paused battle moment: a brass hammer automaton above-left of player at (420,290), green fire-pouch lizard above-right at (835,320), brown quilled beast at (660,560), all scaled like the source enemy sprites, two or three clearly visible orange hostile projectiles spaced through open floor without obscuring actors. Identical arrangement across comparisons. Keep four pillars, same room geometry and same gameplay zoom, no rubble, no added walls or furniture, no theatrical 3D perspective, no decorative poster border, no large title, no UI redesign, no giant VFX. A production-credible 2D overhead game screenshot painted as a style proposal. Consistent overhead sprite lighting, short grounded shadows, furniture top surfaces visible, all characters and environment share a coherent pixel density and palette. Character-led crisp chunky pixel art. Preserve existing protagonist design and simple 3-head-tall proportions almost exactly. Rebuild environment and enemies to match its clean large pixel clusters, flat organized colour masses, 3-4 shades per material, crisp dark silhouette outlines. Strongly remove fine stone grain and photo-like scratches. Floor is quiet cool desaturated slate with subdued joints; pillars charcoal stone and muted warm brass; characters amber/teal/olive remain readable. Rich through deliberate shapes, not texture noise. Warm restrained lantern tint, no bloom blur. Accessible lively handcrafted action-game pixel art, NOT smooth vector illustration. This must visibly simplify the environment compared to the source.
